versions.short: The law directs the Secretary of the Interior to remove all old deed restrictions, such as easements and covenants, from a 3.62-acre parcel of land at 2956 Park Avenue in Paducah, Kentucky, that the federal government previously transferred to the City of Paducah. The city may not sell or transfer the land to anyone other than the Oscar Cross Boys & Girls Club of Paducah, and if the club later receives it, the club must first offer to give the land back to the Secretary at no cost. Any future use of the land must remain compatible with public use or recreation.
